name: every branch is treated as unguarded, so the gate can never fire
expect: a code branch with no review FAILS

name: an EMPTY NO-REVIEW: is accepted as a declaration
edits:
if reason is not None:
        return 0, f"{NO_REVIEW} {reason}"

name: any file under docs/reviews/ counts as a review, not just .md
expect: only .md counts as a review document

name: prose swallows everything, so nothing is ever obliged
edits: return path.endswith(".md") and "/" not in path

name: the named-prose test widens to any .md, so a package README is prose
expect: a .md inside a package is still guarded

name: docs/ stops being prose, so a docs-only branch is obliged
a stale round clears the branch, so code committed after EVERY round merges unreviewed — the whole point of the rule
edits: clean = sorted(n for n, paths in tails.items() if not paths)
expect: code committed after EVERY round FAILS

name: an empty round set is treated as a clean tree instead of NOT CHECKED, so a branch with no round at all reads as reviewed
expect: ...and says NOT CHECKED rather than reporting a clean tree

name: rounds that could not say what they saw stop being counted, so `NOT CHECKED` loses the number that makes it honest
edits:
why = (f"{unusable} round(s) recorded no commit (verdicts written before schema 2)"
               if unusable else "no Codex round was recorded on this branch")
why = "no Codex round was recorded on this branch"
expect: pre-schema-2 verdicts are counted and named, not silently dropped

name: the failure names an arbitrary round rather than the closest one, so the report points away from the shortest way back to green
edits: name, missed = min(tails.items(), key=lambda kv: (len(kv[1]), kv[0]))
name, missed = max(tails.items(), key=lambda kv: (len(kv[1]), kv[0]))
expect: the failure reports the CLOSEST round, not an arbitrary one

name: a review document counts as a verdict, so the tail rule reads prose as testimony about what a round saw
edits: return [p for p in changed if p.startswith(VERDICT_DIR) and p.endswith(".json")]
return [p for p in changed if p.startswith(REVIEW_DIR)]
expect: a review document is not a verdict
